## vendor/GameInput.h

Official Microsoft GameInput SDK header, fetched 2026-11-02 from
`https://github.com/microsoftconnect/GameInput` raw `main` branch
`include/GameInput.h` (47,688 bytes). Microsoft GameInput SDK headers are
published under an MIT-style license; the file itself carries

Role in this PoC: the ABI authority. The interface slot order, enum bit values,
callback signatures and `GameInputDeviceInfo` offsets transcribed in
`src/gameinput.rs` and mirrored/asserted in `src/layout.rs` are cited from this
header by line number. Do not edit in place.
